thread:
kevin.chang: Heads up — Product wants per-route unit economics in Console: token-level cost, cache savings, and model-variant overhead. Can we expose this without blowing up query costs?

lisa: Are they expecting live per-request numbers or aggregated (daily/weekly)? :thinking:

kevin.chang: Start with daily + 1h near-real-time for high-traffic routes. The ask is for route owners to see where cost is coming from (tokens vs model price vs cache).

anna: +1 to daily. UX idea: per-route toggle that shows 'Unit economics' panel with a folded view: summary row (cost/day, effective $/1k tokens, cache savings%) and expandable breakdown by model-variant. Minimal to start. :thumbsup:

michael: Two telemetry caveats: 1) we need to attribute cached responses correctly (prefix vs KV cache hits) 2) fallbacks/routing must be attributed to the caller route, not the fallback model, else numbers are misleading.

lisa: For cache we should show hits as a distinct column and compute savings = (generated_tokens_saved * model_price) - (cache_serving_cost). Estimating serving cost for cache hits is tiny, but include as a footnote.

kevin.chang: Agreed. Also want per-1k-token effective price so PMs can compare quantized variants easily. Example: show both raw unit price and adjusted unit price after cache and batching effects.

michael: Quick query sketch for telemetry folks (needs optimization but gives semantics):
```
SELECT route, model_variant, date_trunc('day', ts) as day,
  sum(tokens_generated) as tokens,
  sum(tokens_saved_by_cache) as tokens_saved,
  sum(cost_nanos) as cost_nanos
FROM telemetry.inference_events
WHERE ts >= $start AND ts < $end
GROUP BY route, model_variant, day;
```
We can compute effective_price_per_1k = (cost_nanos - tokens_saved * model_price_nanos) / (tokens / 1000) later in the pipeline.

anna: Nice. UX note: make the panel default to top 5 cost drivers and allow filtering by model & quantization. Also expose a CSV export for finance.

lisa: Routing policy edge-case: if policy routes to cheaper fallback after X% latency, the cost should still show both pre- and post-fallback counts. We need to surface routing decisions in the panel so engineers understand why cost changed.

kevin.chang: Good call. Add 'routing decision rate' as a metric with small sparkline.

michael: On query cost: compute aggregates in a daily job (cheap) and maintain a 7-day rolling materialized view for the 1h near-real-time. That keeps console queries fast.

deploy-bot: deploy: dashboard/unit-econ-staging -> started

kevin.chang: Action items: 1) michael to prototype telemetry aggregation SQL + materialized view (owns) 2) anna to mock up minimal panel + export (owns) 3) lisa to define attribution rules for cache & fallbacks (collaborate with billing) 4) I'll add spike to eng-platform board.

michael: I'll drop the initial SQL + perf notes in the eng-platform board today. Expect a short spike PR for staging.

anna: I'll put a Figma mock and a tiny copy spec in the ticket. Keeping it compact.

lisa: I'll sync with billing on the attribution math and share a short doc.

kevin.chang: Perfect. If anyone sees a quick win (e.g., reuse existing per-model cost table) call it out. Otherwise let's aim for a small internal beta next week. :eyes:

michael: +1

anna: +1 :rocket:

kevin.chang: Thanks all — closing thread, tracking in the board.
